summary: Completed comprehensive testing of RepLedger MVP with focus on finalized API spec verification. All backend APIs and frontend functionality working correctly. Key verification: POST /v1/agents returns only base fields (no computed fields) and GET /v1/agents returns computed fields as per updated spec.
passed_tests: User signup and login with JWT authentication
API key generation, retrieval, and regeneration
POST /v1/agents returns ONLY base fields (agent_id, name, description, owner_handle, created_at)
GET /v1/agents returns computed fields (score, tier, outcome_count, success_rate, last_updated)
GET /v1/agents/{id}/score returns score data with correct format
GET /v1/agents/{id}/badge.svg public endpoint returns SVG (no auth required)
API key authentication for all v1 endpoints except badge.svg
Scoring logic verification: 60% success rate = Silver tier (5 outcomes)
Frontend homepage loading with proper navigation
Signup/login flow with redirect to dashboard
Dashboard stats display (Total Agents: 0, Total Outcomes: 0)
API key display and copy functionality
Navigation between Dashboard, Agents, API Key, and Docs pages
API documentation page with correct endpoint examples
User session management and authentication flow
Agent creation UI elements and form structure
